Fast L1 (Manhattan) distance to a single query point

dist_l1.Rd

Computes \(d_i = \|X_{i,\cdot} - x_0\|_1\) for each row \(i=1,\dots,n\). If the compiled symbol rustat_dist_l1() is registered (via Rcpp), it is used; otherwise a vectorised R fallback is used.

Usage

dist_l1(X, x0)

Arguments

X

Numeric matrix \(n \times p\). Each row is an observation.

x0

Numeric vector of length \(p\). The query point.

Value

Numeric vector of length \(n\) with L1 distances.

See also

dist_l2(), dist_l1_scaled(), distance_l1(), order_by_l1()

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- matrix(rnorm(12), 4, 3)
x0 <- c(0, 1, -1)
dist_l1(X, x0)
#> [1] 2.872727 2.698723 3.859981 3.246799
